"My thoughts and those of the American people are with the Jewish Community in Belleville following the attack on the Sons of Jacob Synagogue as they commemorated Yom Kippur, the holiest day of the Jewish year. All Canadians should be able to worship without worrying for their safety. The United States has offered assistance to support Canadian law enforcement and the Jewish community," Hoekstra stated.

flash_693913.description:
US resident Donald Trump dismissed claims that the US is running low on munitions as "not true" and spread by "traitors."

Trump wrote on Truth Social: "The cowards and traitors would love to say the United States is low on munitions. It's not true. We have more munitions than we could ever possibly think of using, and are building them up now at levels we have never seen before. President DONALD J. TRUMP"

flash_693912.description: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi has requested US security protection during the UN General Assembly, with the State Department agreeing to provide Diplomatic Security Service personnel after a threat assessment.

flash_693889.description:
The foreign ministers of the G7 countries called on Iran to halt its supply of weapons and support to the Houthi rebels in Yemen. They said the Houthis’ activities were creating a dangerous pattern of escalation that threatened international trade and global stability.

“We strongly condemn the ongoing and unacceptable attacks carried out by the Houthis in Yemen and against Saudi Arabia," the foreign ministers of the United States, Canada, France, Germany, Italy, Japan and the United Kingdom said after meeting on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly.

flash_693933.description:
Sean Ward, the suspect who carried out the shooting attack near the Sons of Jacob synagogue in the town of Belleville, Ontario, died of his wounds in the hospital.

Ward was critically injured in an exchange of gunfire with Officer Jeff Smith on Yom Kippur Eve. The officer was seriously injured and is in stable condition.

flash_693929.description:
A short while ago, 14 Israeli civilians arrived in the Alonei Habashan area and crossed the border into Syria. IDF soldiers were dispatched to the area and operated to locate them and returned the civilians to Israeli territory.

The detained civilians were transferred to the Israel Police for further handling.

flash_693923.description:
Trump at UN General Assembly: Since I took office, it has been my great honor to settle eight wars - numerous of which have gone on for many years, even decades.

The reason I was able to make all these settlements was the use of my relationships, trade, and various other reasons depending on the country.

Among them are Cambodia and Thailand, Kosovo and Serbia, the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Rwanda, Pakistan and India, Armenia and Azerbaijan, and of course, the war in Gaza, which, as I stated previously, includes the return of all hostages both living and dead.

flash_693922.description:
Trump at the UN General Assembly: One year ago when I addressed the great leaders in this Grand Hall, the War in Gaza was still raging brutally, the hostages were still deep in Hamas tunnels, and there was no end in sight.

But here on the sidelines of the General Assembly, we took the first steps that changed everything. A few weeks later, we ENDED the War in Gaza, saving untold thousands of lives. We also brought home ALL remaining hostages, both living and dead.

flash_693920.description: US President Donald Trump said in his address to the UN: "We have more ammunition than we could ever want. We are building it at levels never seen before."

flash_693950.description:
Yashar chairman Gadi Eisenkot criticized remarks by French President Emmanuel Macron, emphasizing that the Hamas terrorist organization also operates in Judea and Samaria and poses a threat to Israeli civilians.

“French President Macron’s statement is radically detached from the reality on the ground. As someone who commanded the Judea and Samaria Division and fought to eradicate Hamas terrorism, I know very well about the terrorist organization’s activities in Judea and Samaria and the threat it poses to Israeli civilians, as we witnessed just two days ago in the deadly attack in Binyamin."

flash_693949.description:
IDF surveillance soldiers on Tuesday evening detected suspicious movement along the Jordanian border in the Jordan Valley area. IDF, Border Police forces in Judea and Samaria, and the Israel Police Judea and Samaria District launched a pursuit.

According to the IDF, two suspects were apprehended shortly afterward and transferred to security forces for further questioning.

flash_693948.description:
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's office on Tuesday evening blasted French President Emmanuel Macron who claimed at the UN that Hamas "has never been very active in Judea and Samaria".

“The grotesque absurdity of Emmanuel Macron's statement is staggering. On Sunday, the eve of Yom Kippur, just two days ago, Netanel Shakron - a FRENCH CITIZEN and father of six - was murdered in his car by a Hamas terrorist in Judea and Samaria. With his final breath, he told his son to run," the statement said. “Hamas terrorists carry out attacks against Jews almost every day. They have murdered countless Israeli civilians in Judea and Samaria. Ignorance is NO EXCUSE for erasing their blood."

flash_693944.description: The French President criticized developments in Judea and Samaria and told the UN General Assembly: “Hamas has never been very active in the West Bank."

flash_694020.description:
US Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee published a message of support for his Israeli counterpart, Ambassador Yechiel Leiter, after the latter's son was severely injured in a ramming attack in the Binyamin Region.

"Pray for Yechiel Leiter & entire family. They lost a son in Gaza, killed by Hamas. Now a Palestinian terrorist attempts to murder IDF soldiers at a checkpoint. Standing with Yechiel Leiter," Huckabee wrote on X.

flash_694018.description:
Ambassador Yechiel Leiter commented on the injury of his son Neria in a terrorist ramming attack.

"I am grateful to the IDF, to the medical team at Shaare Zedek who are now fighting to save the life of Neria Dov ben Chana, and for the prayers of the people of Israel. I believe in the power of prayer, and I believe that when the people of Israel unite, miracles happen. Neria needs a miracle."

He added: "Neria continued to serve in the reserves after losing his older brother, Moshe Yedidya Leiter, of blessed memory. Since October 7th, he has served hundreds of days in the reserves on multiple fronts."

"Palestinian terrorism seeks to uproot the people of Israel from their land. They choose death - we choose life."

flash_694017.description: What would halakha say about Jordan assuming security and administrative responsibility for Areas A and B of Yehuda and Shomron?

flash_694016.description: Israeli Amb. to US Yechiel Leiter returns to Israel after son injured in terror attack

flash_694014.description:
The Binyamin Regional Council announced that reserve soldier Neriya Leiter, the son of Israeli Ambassador to the United States Yechiel Leiter and his wife, Chana, was wounded in Wednesday’s terrorist attack near Route 443.

The family asked the public to pray for the recovery of Neriya Dov ben Chana.

flash_694013.description: Defense Minister Israel Katz rejects Syria’s claim to the Golan Heights and warns that territory captured in response to future attacks will remain Israeli.

flash_694011.description: We posted this article last year but it is even more apt this year, so we are posting it again.

flash_694009.description:
Following a situational assessment and in accordance with the directive of IDF Chief of Staff LTG Eyal Zamir, it was decided that the 98th Division Headquarters will operate in Judea and Samaria and assume command of the Judea and Etzion Brigades.

The activation of the division headquarters in the area is part of strengthening command and control, in order to enhance defensive and offensive capabilities in Judea and Samaria. The IDF noted that this comes after recent events in Judea and Samaria and the need to enhance security during this tense period.

The IDF stated that it continues to conduct continuous situational assessments in accordance with the operational situation.

flash_694008.description: The Joint List responded to the Central Elections Committee’s decision to disqualify the party from running in the elections for the 26th Knesset. “The disqualification of the Joint List is an attempt by Netanyahu and Ben Gvir to steal the election and disenfranchise more than one million citizens," the party stated.

flash_694006.description: Central Elections Committee disqualifies the Joint List after barring Ra’am, Ofer Cassif and Sami Abu Shehadeh.

flash_694005.description: Iran’s Tasnim news agency, which is affiliated with the IRGC, reported that Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi held discussions with US representatives without first coordinating with the appropriate authorities. He was subsequently evacuated to the hospital in serious and unstable condition.

Chinese President Xi Jinping landed at Joint Base Andrews in Maryland on Wednesday, ahead of his summit with US President Donald Trump.

Trump personally arrived at the tarmac to welcome the Chinese president.

flash_694034.description: A Channel 13 News poll shows Naftali Bennett’s Together party falling to a new low of 11 seats, while the Religious Zionist-Zehut alliance remains steady at six.

flash_694030.description:
Shaare Zedek Hospital issued an update on Neria Leiter’s condition, saying, "After undergoing life-saving procedures in the trauma unit, Neria underwent complex brain surgery that lasted several hours, along with additional treatments."

"His condition remains very serious, and his life is in danger. Medical teams, including surgical and intensive care teams, continue to provide Neria with life-saving treatment, while social workers remain closely and sensitively involved in supporting his family throughout."

flash_694029.description: Israeli Embassy spokesperson Tal Naim was with Ambassador Yechiel Leiter in New York when he learned that his son Neria had been critically wounded in a terrorist attack.

flash_694027.description:
Before departing for the UN General Assembly, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu visited Shaare Zedek Medical Center, where he met with the family of Neria Leiter, who was critically wounded in Wednesday’s terrorist attack.

Netanyahu asked the public to pray for the recovery of Neria Dov ben Chana.

flash_694025.description: Netanyahu is reportedly set to spend just seven hours in the US after security officials urged him to minimize his stay amid concrete warnings over the trip.

flash_694021.description:
Israeli President Isaac Herzog issued a statement on Wednesday night offering a prayer for the complete and speedy recovery of Neria Leiter, a reservist soldier who was run over today in a terror attack at the Maccabim checkpoint.

Herzog noted that Leiter is the brother of Major Moshe Leiter, of blessed memory, a hero of Israel who fell at the beginning of the Swords of Iron War in Gaza.

“We send our wishes for a complete recovery to Neria, and strength to his wife and to his parents, Hannah and Yechiel Leiter, Israel's Ambassador to the United States. Neria is fighting for his life at this very hour, and we will pray for his recovery. We all stand with this dear family and send them our strength," Herzog stated.

flash_694019.description: Neria Leiter, son of Israeli Ambassador to the US Yechiel Leiter, was critically wounded in the ramming attack on Route 443. Ambassador: "Neria needs a miracle."
